items.exampleEn: The hotel replaced the old drapery in every room.
items.exampleZh: 飯店把每個房間的舊窗簾都換掉了。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother made this blue cardigan for me by hand.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶親手為我織了這件藍色開襟毛衣。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant uses heavy silverware on every table.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳每桌都用厚重的銀製餐具。

items.exampleEn: Fields of flax turn blue when the plants flower.
items.exampleZh: 亞麻開花時，整片田會變成藍色。

items.exampleEn: The waistcoat had six small buttons down the front.
items.exampleZh: 那件背心前面有六顆小鈕扣。

items.exampleEn: My little sister left all her dolls undressed on the floor.
items.exampleZh: 妹妹把她所有的娃娃都脫掉衣服，丟在地上。
items.glossZh: 沒穿衣服的；脫了衣服的

items.exampleEn: Divers search for pearls at the bottom of the sea.
items.exampleZh: 潛水員在海底尋找珍珠。

items.exampleEn: She tore the old sheet into tatters to use as cleaning cloths.
items.exampleZh: 她把舊床單撕成碎布條，拿來當抹布。

items.sentenceEn: It's cold in the office, so I always keep a cardigan on my chair.
items.sentenceZh: 辦公室很冷，所以我總是在椅子上放一件開襟毛衣。

items.audioEn: Please polish the silverware before the guests arrive at seven.
items.audioZh: 請在客人七點抵達前把銀製餐具擦亮。

items.sentenceEn: Her old jeans were in tatters after years of hard work.
items.sentenceZh: 她的舊牛仔褲穿了好幾年，已經破爛不堪。

items.sentenceEn: The children got undressed and jumped into the pool.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們脫了衣服，跳進游泳池。

items.stemEn: Long ago, farmers grew ____ to make cloth for clothes.
items.stemZh: 很久以前，農夫種亞麻來織做衣服的布。

items.stemEn: She wore a ____ necklace that her mother had given her.
items.stemZh: 她戴著媽媽送的珍珠項鍊。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I helped my aunt clear out her old house. In one old cupboard, we found a gray cardigan, a dark waistcoat that belonged to my grandfather, and a dress woven from flax grown on the family farm. Some of the curtains were in tatters, but the heavy drapery in the living room still looked grand. In a wooden box, we found a set of silverware and a string of pearls. My aunt said the pearls were timeless, but the silverware looked dated. When we finished, my cousin's little boy ran around half undressed, refusing to put on his shirt, and we all laughed.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我幫阿姨清理她的老房子。在一個舊櫥櫃裡，我們找到一件灰色開襟毛衣、一件爺爺穿過的深色背心，還有一件用自家農場種的亞麻織成的洋裝。有些窗簾已經破爛不堪，但客廳裡厚重的布幔看起來依然很氣派。在一個木盒裡，我們找到一組銀製餐具和一串珍珠。阿姨說珍珠永不過時，但那組銀器看起來有點過時。整理完時，表親的小兒子衣服只穿一半就到處跑，不肯穿上襯衫，大家都笑了。

questions.questionZh: 他們在木盒裡找到了什麼？
options: 爺爺的照片和一疊舊信
一組銀製餐具和一串珍珠

questions.questionZh: 阿姨怎麼評論那串珍珠？

items.promptZh: 他在襯衫外面穿了一件背心。

He put on a waistcoat over his shirt.

items.promptZh: 我的開襟毛衣洗過之後縮水了。
referenceEn: My cardigan shrank after I washed it.
After I washed it, my cardigan became smaller.
rubricZh: cardigan 指「開襟毛衣」（例如 my cardigan 等）
「縮水」可寫，例如 shrank、has shrunk、became smaller 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式
